column1: # German (de) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Feature names (tabs, groups, buttons, menu items, dialog fields, cell style names) use the
# established terms German Excel users know: Start, Einfügen, Seitenlayout, Formeln, Daten,
# Überprüfen, Ansicht, Bedingte Formatierung, Als Tabelle formatieren, Fenster fixieren …
# CLAUDE.md allows Excel feature names. No string table, resource file or other localisation file
# of any product was read or copied, and longer texts (tooltips, explanations, messages) were
# written from the meaning of the English source.
# Conventions: address the user as "Sie"; "z. B."; a space before % ("10 %").
# `Group › Label` keys are scoped entries (`i18n::t_at`) for English words German Excel names two
# ways, e.g. Font = Schriftart (Home) and Schrift (Format Cells tab).
# Product, format and technology names (GridCraft, CSV, PDF, MCP, PivotTable …) stay as they are.
